messages:
Maya (People Ops): FYI - Carlos's new manager hire (starting Mon) 1 1 I sketched a preboard + week1 checklist focused on manager needs (access, finance approvals, team intros). Please add gaps. TL;DR below.
Carlos (Hiring Manager): Thanks! Two quick Qs: expense card setup timelines? and does IT ship laptop overnight?
Asha (IT): If procurement form submitted by Thu we can ship overnight. For expense card (virtual) finance needs manager approval and headcount code. See template below for procurement + card request.
Asha (IT): ```Procurement ticket:
- Name: [New Manager]
- Start: YYYY-MM-DD
- Device: Macbook/Existing
- Requires: Okta, GSuite, GitHub org, AWS staging access, Vault read
- Manager approver: [Manager Name]
- Expense card: yes/no, headcount code
```
Lina (Finance): For corporate card: manager should email headcount code + expected monthly spend. Virtual card can be issued same-week after approvals. Physical card takes 5-7 days.
Ben (Infra): For demo capacity requests, file in #eng-infra with: service, region, expected qps, retention. Small demo pools <24h we can often provision same day if request before 3pm PT.
Carlos (Hiring Manager): Can we get a buddy from infra? Prefer someone who knows staging and deploy flow.
Ben (Infra): I can buddy wk1. Day2 I'll run a 45m staging tour + deploy walkthrough.
onboard-bot: Calendar: "Manager Preboard - Docs + Access" created for carlos@redwood.com.
Maya (People Ops): Preboard -> Week1 checklist (compact):
- Preboard (3-5 days before): procurement ticket, headcount code to Finance, Okta invite sent, enroll MFA, GitHub org invite, SSH key requested.
- Day0 (evening before start): confirm device delivered or pickup, expense card status, calendar seats created for intro meetings.
- Day1: 30m manager 1:1 + access verification (Okta/GitHub/AWS), security briefing, add to oncall channels if needed.
- Day2: infra buddy walkthrough (staging, deploy flow, demo env request), meet product partner.
- Day3: pair on small triage or PR, meet direct reports in 1:1s.
- Day4: draft 30/60/90 and prioritize top 3 outcomes, sync with hiring manager.
- Day5: kickoff ownership task + retrospective on week1, confirm any remaining approvals (KMS/Vault).
Carlos (Hiring Manager): I'll post a short 30/60/90 draft by Fri. My expectations: 30d - learn code and team priorities; 60d - lead a bugfix/feature delivery; 90d - own a cross-team reliability or perf improvement.
Asha (IT): Okta invite sent to carlos.new@redwood.com 1 enroll MFA asap and upload SSH pubkey at settings.github.com/new. If device imaging fails, DM me with screenshot.
Lina (Finance): Please cc: finance-ops on the approval email (finance@redwood.com). Attach PO or headcount note.
Maya (People Ops): Great thread. Carlos - drop your 30/60/90 here and we'll route approvals. Welcome aboard in advance! :tada:
